title: Hearty Springy Algerian Rice Stick Noodles
description: A tangy and cozy Algerian dish featuring rice stick noodles and kombu cold extract, this recipe is nut free friendly and perfect for a weeknight dinner. It combines the flavors of Africa and Asia in a unique and delicious way.
instructions: Combine the kombu and cold water in a large bowl and let it sit at room temperature for at least 4 hours or overnight.
Remove the kombu from the water and cut it into small pieces.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the cooked rice stick noodles to the skillet and stir to combine with the spice mixture.
Add the kombu pieces to the skillet and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes and serve hot.
